name: @polymarket-bot/inventory
description: Collateral inventory and wallet operations (WP-300, handoff §9.14): account-level pUSD and outcome-token inventory with available/reserved/pending amounts, a serialized reservation service that makes double reservation impossible, and a wallet-operation state machine (approvals, split, merge, redeem, pUSD wrap/unwrap) whose UNKNOWN outcomes trigger reconciliation. Layer-1 logic: no I/O, no clock, no key, no RPC, no credential; wallet operations execute only through an injected port. No bridge, withdrawal, deposit or transfer path exists.
